name: jiean-design-system
description: JIEAN Design System. Style packages: 'arco-blue' (阿科蓝), an enterprise application design language reverse engineered from Arco Design Pro for JIEAN (捷安高科); 'brandcolor', that same system expressed in the JIEAN brand colours; and 'industrial-steel-blue' (工业钢蓝), an independent adaptation of the same baseline to a cool, deep steel blue. Specified with the Google DESIGN.md format.
